Q: JavaScript for a collapsible which expands on click A:

I think you must have the script tag before the closing of the body not after it.

The problem is here let updateContent = this.closest(".update-content");

change it to let updateContent = this.parentElement.querySelector(".update-content");

The closest() is supposed to be searching upword and in your html the parent of .update-content is .update.

Q: std::uncaught_exception does not work across DLL boundaries A:

Use /MD the dynamic runtime compiler option.

Without one, the main executable and each DLL all have their very own copy of the runtime, with all its internal state replicated for each module.
